dedupe_keys.name: tsyganenko geomagnetic field model and geopack libraries

description: The Tsyganenko model family estimates magnetospheric magnetic fields from empirical fits to satellite measurements. Different formulations represent major current systems and use solar-wind or geomagnetic drivers. The resource is documented by Univ. of St.-Petersburg, Russia. The documented physical domain is Magnetosphere / Global Magnetosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Each formulation has different drivers and validity assumptions; the family is not a single universally calibrated field model. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
